raw_library_record.notes: Uncaptioned photocopy plate (page printed rotated). Kimball house complete with iron fence on a stone coping and a low stone wall along 18th Street; a row of tall stone houses to the south (Coleman 1811, Sears/Meeker 1815, Dent 1823, Doane 1827 tower); bare parkway elms; smooth roadway with curbs at the corner, broad sidewalk, a lamp/sign post at the curb. Date not given; consistent with c.1890s–1900s (Kimball completed 1892). Strong candidate view for the 1904 corner — find the original (lead: CHM; the report's bibliography cites the Chicago Daily News rotogravure 'This Is Prairie Avenue', 25 Aug. 1951).
